descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-11 Course Timeline · S12 Double tap on Generate, and leaving the chart while the note and timeline are still being written

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T3 Re-completing a note (Regenerate) never creates a second entry. (TFA-92589 AC 3; TFA-92589 2026-10-02 comment)
  • T2 A new timeline entry is created automatically on every completed note, generated from that day's finished note. (TFA-92589 AC 2; TFA-92589 description 1)
  • U1 One entry per completed visit, correctly dated, in chronological order, never duplicated. (UAT TC-11; TFA-92589 AC 3)

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Fixture Hospital patient {hospitalPatient} and resident {snfResident} with no course, plus a second Hospital patient {hospitalPatient2} and a second resident {snfResident2} whose names do not contain the first ones' (e.g. 'QA Second <tag>'). Run twice: variant a — both second charts have an empty course; …

When Hospital: double-click Generate Note & Finish on {hospitalPatient}; then press Regenerate Note and at once go back to the list and open {hospitalPatient2}; reopen {hospitalPatient}, then {hospitalPatient2} again. …

Then {hospitalPatient} has one card dated today. {snfResident} has its note and one 'Visit 1 – <today>' line, not 'Encounter done'. Neither second chart gains, loses or changes anything, on screen or in storage, before or after the first chart's refresh lands

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs, scoped to the course panels, plus the post-run storageCheck, which decides the wrong-patient question: the refresh writes seconds after Generate (EncounterTab.tsx refreshCourse; useNoteGeneration.ts getLatestPatient + savePatient), so the late snapshots and storage are what count. …

Where it ran: dev; test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S12 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-11.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on dev; Source: dev.
